articles.title: Earth Wasn't Made of Space Junk from Far Away, Scientists Say
articles.summary: Scientists thought some of Earth's building blocks came from the far edge of the solar system. A new study says almost all of it came from right next door — and they were "truly astonished."

articles.title: Some Great Lakes Fish May Be Older Than Your Whole Family Tree
articles.summary: Lake sturgeon in the Great Lakes might live more than 400 years, a new study suggests — nearly three times older than the previous record. One scientist says all sturgeon now need a re-check.

articles.title: Orcas Are Smashing Sunfish Like Piñatas — and Scientists Filmed It
articles.summary: New footage shows orcas ramming dead sunfish so hard the fish explode. Scientists think it might be to break food into bites for young orcas — or just for fun.
